hero.tagline: The whole RAG chain, under control.
hero.subtitle: Index your corpora, measure your search, plug in your agents.
hero.arg1_text: Models, chunking, enrichment prompts, search weighting — per workspace, no redeployment.
hero.arg2_title: Usable by your agents through MCP
hero.arg2_text: Querying the index and building the workspace (creation, sources, chunking, search) as MCP tools — same scopes, same traceability.
hero.arg3_text: Git, webhook or REST: every push leaves a traceable, replayable job with its rejection reason.
hero.arg4_text: Hybrid search and reranking, measured: score, source and excerpt for every hit.
